What You'll Get

This lab analyzes your product positioning through the lens of Generative Engine Optimization (GEO). You'll receive:

  • GEO Visibility Score (1-10) with detailed explanation
  • Specificity Analysis — which claims are too vague for AI to cite
  • Quick Wins — 3 changes to immediately improve AI visibility
  • Rewrite Examples — before/after versions of your claims
  • Test Queries — buyer questions where you should appear
